attributes.board_name: Minnesota Department of Health, Speech-Language Pathologist and Audiologist Licensing

rules.accepted_credit_types: Organized programs from sponsors meeting Minn. Stat. §148.5193 subd. 2 (no pre-approval required); teaching CE courses at 2 contact hours per teaching hour (max 6 per period); for SLPs also licensed by PELSB, approved educator clock hours (1 clock hour = 1 contact hour). Alternatively, meeting the CE requirements of ASHA or the American Board of Audiology is accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licenses issued for less than two years: hours are prorated by the months licensed in the biennial period.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; contact hours may not be accumulated in advance.
rules.audit_note: CE reporting form (or ASHA/ABA documentation) is submitted with the renewal in the MDH Licensing System; random audits; keep records 4 years.
rules.notes: 30 contact hours = at least 20 directly related to the area of licensure + up to 10 generally related. Licensed as both SLP and audiologist: 36 contact hours (at least 15 in SLP, at least 15 in audiology, up to 6 generally related). The CE period runs from the effective date of the current license to its expiration date; evidence is due within one month after expiration. No state-mandated topics.

rules.new_licensee_rule: Licenses issued for less than two years: hours are prorated by the months licensed in the biennial period.
rules.audit_note: Upload the SLPA CE Reporting Form with the renewal application; keep certificates or transcripts, MDH may request them.
rules.notes: 20 contact hours = at least 13 directly related to the area of licensure + up to 7 generally related. CEUs are converted to contact hours on the reporting form (e.g. 1 CEU = 10 contact hours). Minn. Stat. §148.5193 subd. 1a also refers to ASHA CE requirements for assistants.
